Definition: from a compound of G303 and G3056; proportion:--proportion.
BiblicalUsage: The word appears once: having gifts differing according to the grace given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith. It is the measure — the proportion — and Paul ties the exercise of prophecy to the measure of faith God has given.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for proportion carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the measure — prophesy according to the faith you have been given, no more and no less.
